Apache-2.0. Worker third-party notices are in worker-LICENSE.txt and bundle-LICENSE.txt.
Source: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js and https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core and https://github.com/naptha/tessdata
Retrieved from the official npm registry; npm tarball SHA-512 integrity was verified before extraction.
All recognition stays on-device. No CDN is used at runtime. The three LSTM wasm.js bundles embed their WebAssembly data.
